    update the Command Line Reference Guide (doc/Command-Reference.md) to reflect
    your changes.

    Please provide the following information:
-->

#### What I did
Modify the lldpshow script to fix the output of the "show lldp table"  and "show lldp neighbors" on the multi-asic Linecard.  Fixes  https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/19209

#### How I did it
After PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-host-services/pull/120, lldp service is no longer enabled in localhost on the multi-asic Linecard.  To avoid the "show lldp table" command to access the lldp container which doesn't exist in the multi-asic linecard, this commit adds a new function get_feature_state_data() in the general.py to query the feature table to derive the globa_scope  and per_asic_scope value and modifies the lldpshow script to check if the lldp feature is enabled in scope before it is added to instance list for the show command.  Also fix the lldp_args list which contains list of interface port instead of all ports in one element to allow the subprocess.Popen call without "shell=True" parameters. 

#### How to verify it
1)  On the multi-asic lindecard. execute the "show  lldp table"  and "show lldp neighbors" commands, the message "Error response from daemon: No such container: lldp" should not be shown on the CLI output
